AboutMeMsg: Full Stack .NET developer with ~6 years of commercial experience, primarily in data-heavy and transactional products. Extensive experience with legacy .NET Framework 4.8 — support, extension and gradual modernization, including splitting monoliths into .NET Core microservices. Payment systems: MasterCard integration, PCI DSS, SSL management on Azure. Confident across the full cycle — from PO requirements to production release.
Exp1Description: Product analytics platform: session replay, report sharing, dashboards and BI on top of ClickHouse.
Exp1Detail0: Designed and shipped a Session Replay system: user sessions reconstructed from screenshot sequences with overlays forclicks, taps and swipes, plus variable playback speed. Product teams use it to see where users get stuck and validate A/B hypotheses qualitatively, not just by the numbers.
Exp1Detail1: Optimized ClickHouse queries for dashboards: rendering ~10M events cut from 8 s to 1.8 s.
Exp1Detail2: Implemented report sharing with granular access control via Azure AD SSO.
Exp1Detail3: Built dashboard components on Ant Design Charts and MudBlazor for funnel and customer-journey visualisations. Backend handles around 10M raw events per day; charts render in under 2 seconds.
Exp2Description: Support and gradual modernization of a legacy .NET Framework 4.8 CRM on Code On Time, plus payment integration.
Exp2Detail0: Integrated MasterCard payment gateway — 0 incidents in the first 6 months in production.
Exp2Detail1: Brought payment forms to PCI DSS compliance and automated SSL certificate renewal on Azure App Service.
Exp2Detail2: Added Telegram OAuth and UGC features — audience grew to 2,000 active users in 3 months.
Exp3Description: Logistics audit for three enterprise clients: 12M+ shipments per month.
Exp3Detail0: Designed a Rule Engine with UI-configurable business rules — business team eliminated 80% of dev requests.
Exp3Detail1: Sustained 12M+ shipments/month with no performance degradation on SQL Server + Azure Service Bus.
Exp3Detail2: Implemented RBAC + JWT with client-level access granularity — three enterprise accounts in a single instance.
Exp3Detail3: Integrated Google Maps for live cargo tracking — real-time route visualization.
Exp4Description: Large legacy .NET Framework 4.8 monolith in healthcare analytics, gradual split into .NET Core microservices.
Exp4Detail0: Extracted the first 3 domains from the monolith into .NET Core services with zero user downtime.
Exp4Detail1: Grew test coverage from 200 to 500+ tests — caught 12 regressions before they hit production.
Exp4Detail2: Configured Kubernetes + Rancher: deploy time cut from 40 min to 8 min.
Exp4Detail3: Set up Kibana/Grafana/Logstash monitoring — proper stack traces instead of "something broke".
Exp5Description: Swiss real-estate startup. Search, map, analytics, lead generation.
Exp5Detail0: Implemented Elasticsearch for real estate search — response time noticeably better than the previous SQL search.
Exp5Detail1: High-load backend API for analytics dashboards.
Exp5Detail2: MapBox integration for detailed property and rental info on the map.
Exp5Detail3: Mustache.js email templates for listings — marketing started collecting more leads.

Proj2Description: Funnel and customer-journey visualizations on Ant Design Charts and MudBlazor. Backend processes ~10M raw events per day; charts render in under 2 seconds.
